symptom: API failed to start locally with 'RESEND_API_KEY is required' even for developers not using the email feature
rootcause: ResendEmailSenderAdapter instantiated the Resend SDK client eagerly in its constructor, which called ConfigService.getOrThrow('RESEND_API_KEY') at module startup time. Developers without this env var set could not start the API at all
fix: Changed the Resend client to be lazy-initialized on first use — ConfigService is called only when sendPasswordResetEmail or sendInviteEmail is actually invoked
